item.text: [{"task_id":"a09f6c25","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    foreground = int(round(params['colors'][0]))","    horizontal_color = int(round(params['colors'][1]))","    vertical_color = int(round(params['colors'][2]))","    diagonal_color = int(round(params['colors'][3]))","    noise_limit = int(round(params['noise'][0]))","    directions = [(int(round(pair[0])), int(round(pair[1]))) for pair in params['neighbors']]","    values, counts = np.unique(grid, return_counts=True)","    background = int(values[np.argmax(counts)])","    result = np.full(grid.shape, background, dtype=int)","    height, width = grid.shape","    seen = set()","    for position in np.argwhere(grid == foreground):","        start = (int(position[0]), int(position[1]))","        if start in seen:","            continue","        seen.add(start)","        pending = [start]","        component = set()","        while pending:","            row, col = pending.pop()","            component.add((row, col))","            for dr, dc in directions:","                nr, nc = row + dr, col + dc","                if 0 <= nr < height and 0 <= nc < width:","                    point = (nr, nc)","                    if point not in seen and grid[nr, nc] == foreground:","                        seen.add(point)","                        pending.append(point)","        if len(component) <= noise_limit:","            continue","        top = min(row for row, col in component)","        bottom = max(row for row, col in component)","        left = min(col for row, col in component)","        right = max(col for row, col in component)","        horizontal = {(top + bottom - row, col) for row, col in component}","        vertical = {(row, left + right - col) for row, col in component}","        if horizontal == component:","            color = horizontal_color","        elif vertical == component:","            color = vertical_color","        else:","            color = diagonal_color","        for row, col in component:","            result[row, col] = color","    return result"],"shapes":{"colors":[4],"noise":[1],"neighbors":[4,2]},"params":{"colors":[2,1,3,6],"noise":[1],"neighbors":[[-1,0],[1,0],[0,-1],[0,1]]},"rationale":"Remove isolated red pixels.
